messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired -> PD#789012 | service: inference-runtime-eu | severity: high | symptom: sustained 5xx rate > 1.5% (60s) | link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/789012
pagerduty: Auto-routing: eng-oncall (eu). Notification sent to rotation. Duplicate suppression: active
maya: acked. I'm on it, taking ownership. joining zoom, will run quick health checks and surface customer impact.
jen: FYI CS flagged checkout/timeouts from ToastPay. Customers seeing delayed receipts and retries. Passing list to oncall.
maya: quick triage: pods in pool-gpu-2 show evictions + high 5xx. `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-runtime` shows several CrashLoop/OOM restarts. No recent model deploy.
alex: looking at metrics — KV cache eviction rate spiked right before the 5xx surge. Autoscaler also triggered a scale-down ~3m before spike (maybe a race).
incident-bot: Autoscaler event detected at 1769812300: scaledown to 2 replicas (policy: cpu-based, window=5m)
maya: scaling to 6 replicas now to soak traffic: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-runtime --replicas=6 -n prod` -> applied. warming pods.
soufiane: I can stand up a watch and take over if you need to step out, @maya.
maya: handing to @soufiane — notes: scale-up in flight, watch runtime logs for `OutOfMemory` and long GC pauses. Customer impact: intermittent 5xx affecting checkout endpoints. CS notified.
soufiane: acked and taking over. Running quick log grep: `tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/runtime.log | grep -i "oom\|evict\|killed"` and patching HPA min replicas if needed.
jen: any config changes recently? rollback candidate?
alex: no model or code deploys last 12h. There was an HPA threshold tweak in last config PR (commit fa3b2) that lowered the CPU target. That could make scale-down more aggressive.
soufiane: applying temporary mitigation: `kubectl patch hpa/inference-hpa -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'` and rolling back HPA target to previous commit fa3b2 -> fa2b1.
incident-bot: Duplicate pages suppressed during mitigation: 3 suppressed (identical symptom).
pagerduty: PD#789012 assigned to soufiane (eng-oncall). Acknowledged at 1769812352.
soufiane: status: scale-up completed, pods healthy 6/6. HPA minReplicas bumped to 4, threshold rollback applied. KV eviction rate down ~85% vs peak. Error rate trending down.
maya: summary for runbook: probable root cause = autoscaler scale-down during a traffic burst + hot cache evictions -> transient OOMs/5xx. No model regressions.
jen: customer impact estimate? CS needs numbers for postmortem comms.
soufiane: estimate: ~2.5 minute window of elevated 5xx, impacting ~4% of checkout requests routed through eu-region during spike. CS has request IDs for retries. No data exfiltration.
maya: I'll draft an incident note and add timeline (scale-down -> eviction -> 5xx -> scale-up -> HPA rollback). Moving to postmortem queue after closure.
soufiane: I'll keep the quiet window for 10m and close PD if no further pages.
incident-bot: PD#789012 resolved by soufiane at 1769812389. Short summary: transient autoscaler/HPA configuration interaction caused scale-down during burst; mitigations: scale-up, HPA minReplicas bump, rollback HPA threshold. Customer impact: brief increased latency/5xx to checkout endpoints; CS notified.
maya: thanks folks :thumbsup:
